messages.author: 224d0e4a7c73c348
messages.subject: Not accepting assignment statements
parts:
In a relatively simple autoregressive model I declare in the data block:
int N;
vector[N] x;
vector[N] y;
...
and in the parameters block:

real alpha;
real beta;
...
and in the model block:

vector[N] yhat;
alpha ~ cauchy(abar,asig);
beta ~ cauchy(betabar,betasig);

yhat=beta*x+alpha;

 and get error:

Illegal statement beginning with non-void expression parsed as
  yhat
Not a legal assignment, sampling, or function statement.


I also get a similar error if I write this in loop format. Am I not allowed to create a vector in the model block? Is there something else going on?

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Not accepting assignment statements
parts:
Currently, all variable declarations must come at the start of any block. If there are any statements between the declaration of yhat and the start of the block, "{", you'll see a message like the one you're getting. 



Daniel

P.S. It really helps to post the whole Stan program. I'm just guessing as to what's wrong. 
P.P.S. It also helps to have the whole error message.
